versions.subject: adding gui input capture, first iteration
versions.detection:
selection1:
    ProcessName:
        - '/usr/sbin/osascript'
selection2:
    Commandline|contains|all:
        - '-e'
        - 'display'
        - 'dialog'
        - 'answer'
selection3:
    Commandline|contains:
        - 'admin'
        - 'administrator'
        - 'authenticate'
        - 'authentication'
        - 'credentials'
        - 'pass'
        - 'password'
        - 'unlock'
condition: all of them
versions.spl: ProcessName="/usr/sbin/osascript" Commandline="*-e*" Commandline="*display*" Commandline="*dialog*" Commandline="*answer*" Commandline IN ("*admin*", "*administrator*", "*authenticate*", "*authentication*", "*credentials*", "*pass*", "*password*", "*unlock*")
